knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The scratch is listed with its location and assigned to the responsible trade or person. Ignoring it or painting over it without a record both hide an open item.
The sign-off covers the cleaning checked against the agreed criteria, with exceptions listed. It is not a regulatory clearance or a statement that the building is finished.
Open items are listed, not hidden, and only the checked work is signed off. A verbal or written request from the client does not change this.

practicalCriteria: Compiles a defect list for a mock area, with a number, location, factual description and category for each item.
Separates cleaning, trade, damage and unknown items, and names the responsible trade or person for each.
Checks the mock work against written acceptance criteria before the sign-off.
Signs off only the checked work, lists the exceptions, and does not use clearance or guarantee wording.
Reissues the list with a date after a simulated item is resolved, rather than editing the old list.
passRule: Defect list complete, items categorised and assigned, sign-off limited to checked work with exceptions listed, and no clearance wording. Observed by an assessor. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Defect and punch list with categories and responsible persons
stopWorkCriteria: Sign-off completed with items open or hidden
Sign-off described as a clearance, certificate or guarantee
Ladder or platform used to inspect high points without training or site authority
